notes: DIRECT - GREAT Term: premium left out. The brochure says the premium is guaranteed for GREAT Term but its closing note says the premium charged is not guaranteed and may be revised, with no indication of which plan type that note covers. No entry age or no-medical-renewal statement was found.
DIRECT - GREAT Term covers two plan types (GREAT Term and GREAT 5yr Term); term, TPD and TI cells cover both. TPD/TI cells are for the base plan without the Critical Care rider.
Great Eastern Cares Term Plan: no TPD cell; the page and brochure list death and terminal illness only, which does not state 'No' to TPD. Offered only to Special Needs Trust Company clients.

GREAT Critical Cover Series: entry age and waiting period are not in text sources (brochure pages 3-4 are images; the page only states 12/24-month gaps between rider claims). Complete and Top 3 CIs are two base plans; the claims cell describes the Protect Me Again rider. The comparison table's 'No. of CI conditions' row reads '121 CI conditions' / '9 CI conditions', which looks like a footnote digit fused into the number, so it was not used.

GREAT TotalCare 2 is the Great Eastern Shield-style rider (attached to GREAT SupremeHealth). Its panel and non-panel co-payment cap cells in the benefit table are blank or N.A. in the extracted text, so panel is left out; the 5% / 10% co-payments in the table apply to special benefits, not to the Shield co-insurance.
GREAT Term 2: no entry age found; the 5% premium discount promotion is ignored.
